race.comment: NOTHING I WANT (3) did a good job to finish second here two runs back then things went sour last time when she broke and finished a long way back in seventh over 2230m at this track. Big chance if she behaves in this similar assignment. MAORI TATTOO (2) was in the money two starts back when finishing second over today's course and distance then things went wrong last start when he broke and finished a distant 11th over 2230m at this track. On his best form can play a major role. EMILY MEAGAN (1) is on the radar after her last-start fifth over 1800m at this track a week ago after she raced six back on  the pegs at the bell. LOW LIE THE FIELDS (6) is tough to leave out on the back of two successive wins, most recently at this track a week ago when using the sprint lane to score a game victory over 1800m.
